name: Raleigh Youth Council
org: City of Raleigh Parks, Recreation and Cultural Resources, Teen Programs
what_you_do: Speak up for teens in Raleigh and Wake County. You do community service, build leadership skills, help with fundraisers and events, and can go to the Youth Legislative Assembly and state youth council meetings.
who_can_apply: High school students. The page names Raleigh and Wake County and lists no other rule.
duration: Meetings every second and fourth Monday of the month, 7 to 8 p.m.
deadline_text: No deadline. You can join by coming to the next meeting.
how_to_apply: Contact Nieya Garland at 984-338-6150, or register on RecLink and go to a meeting.
notes: The page says it is a good way to get school volunteer hours. Teen Programs: Teens@raleighnc.gov, 919-996-2139.
